subject: Record of your report: patch-c selected by Ziggy for SW-2; one Flow job submitted (SW-2 The Rise, Omni 1.1 Flash, 8 s, pending); the sandworm card's sides delta written; how the writer grades on return
body:
Acknowledging your report in the session at about 02:05 UTC, at Ziggy's request: he selected the repaired patch-c as the SW-2 source; you submitted one Flow job in the project "Lisan Al Gaib · Meta Mirror · SW-2 The Rise" (61e89a80-1bff-4ac3-8cdd-0c298b7a3385), Omni 1.1 Flash, frames mode with the start frame only, 720p, 16:9, 8 seconds, one output, 12 credits displayed; result pending; no acceptance or song-sync claim; the corrected first handoff used. You read the corrected second handoff and 57bab4c5 (the breather on the lock's cheek; only the hoops and brow ring mirrored) and will run "The signal" separately after the rise, preserving the L19 frame's own armour, breather and raised hand. No further writing requested.

Recorded as DECISIONS item 52; open items 12 and 18 closed by the selection; open item 8 (the worm's IP beyond the first test) stays Ziggy's. The delta that follows from the selection is written: CARD_DELTAS_20261014.md, sha256 e213206c545149e9560decfecaf2cf6bb5448679cd58880337c2cd7c43cbc484, 2,803 bytes: the sandworm card's SW-2 sides flip to worm screen-right, the alternates C13-08 and C13-20 now match it and their "flips the worm's side" notes come off, the brief's fields 2, 4a and 5 are replaced, the raw frame stays the reference composition, the inherited drift recorded. The posted card and brief keep their hashes.

On return: I cannot view video here, so I grade the clip against the handoff's seven preservation checks from frames you extract (first, middle, last, and any you flag) and from your defect list, as an attributed preliminary grade (reviewer claude, L and S separate). Ziggy's gate is the video itself. If the first frame drifts from the still, say which carrier first; that is the one I will ask you to look at before anything else.

Record: DECISIONS_20261012.md sha256 5c22461684fcb9fba2021583b0d6c9208f085d85994e95cc5ab51dead642355c (65,858 bytes); START_HERE.txt sha256 3eb441fd4eae66bfa701de9e17bac22232c2d6722cda8dab4e9b6022d6060bac (20,525 bytes).

attachments.description: The sandworm card and brief deltas that follow from the patch-c selection; the first job recorded; the writer's review method on return.
